# is aware of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/isAwareOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Faintest level of the knowledge spectrum: the agent has encountered the subject and knows it exists, without necessarily knowing facts about it. Entailed by every deeper level ([`knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md), understands, [`hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md)) and by [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the shallowest objectual knowledge relation — the agent has merely encountered a subject and knows it exists — or to query every agent at that depth or deeper, since the deeper levels entail it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when a deeper level holds (assert that level and let it entail this one), avoid it for propositional belief about a claim (that is the epistemics slice), and avoid it for the 'can do' axis (that is [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md)).

### How to use

- Assert the deepest level that truly holds and read the shallower ones by subproperty entailment; carry whose-knowledge and how-deep as a vantage-indexed claim on the statement layer when it is contested or attributed.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) ex:quantumComputing.
